name: minimal-express-app
description: Minimal Express app with scalable structure

scripts.start:ci: cross-env NODE_ENV=production CI=true HOST=0.0.0.0 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=384 --heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=1" GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false node src/server.js
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development CI=${CI:-false} DISABLE_WATCH=1 HOST=0.0.0.0 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=384 --heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=1" GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false node src/server.js
scripts.dev:lean: cross-env NODE_ENV=development CI=${CI:-false} DISABLE_WATCH=1 HOST=0.0.0.0 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=384 --heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=1" GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false node src/server.js
scripts.dev:watch: cross-env NODE_ENV=development HOST=0.0.0.0 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=512 --heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=1" GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false BROWSERSLIST_DISABLE_CACHE=1 nodemon --watch src --ext js,json --ignore "src/**/__tests__/**" --signal SIGINT src/server.js
scripts.docs: echo 'Swagger UI at http://localhost:3001/api-docs (alias: /docs)' && node -e "console.log('OpenAPI JSON at /openapi.json')"
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Skipping heavy Browserslist DB update in CI. Run locally if needed: npx update-browserslist-db@latest --yes' || true
